title: La Kour — Fénoir (English)
description:
December, Réunion Island. The lychees are ripening, Christmas is being prepared under the filao trees, the radio is talking about a strange fever at the hospital. Tonight, someone you know did not get back up the way they should have.

Fénoir is an original survival game: you arrive on day zero of the Grey, on an island you love. Every action costs time, and the island changes while you play: networks go down, hordes of the Pallid, gangs, cyclones. Find the right place for a shelter, fit it out, manage water, food, energy and morale; then choose: move on further with what you have learned, or put down roots until you are self-sufficient — cistern, vegetable garden, solar panels, galleries. Solo with AI companions, with friends, or both; run by the AI GM or by a human game master.
